lints.name: unindexed_foreign_keys

lints.name: auth_rls_initplan
lints.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
lints.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

findings.detail: Table \`public.tools\` has a row level security policy \`tools_select_auth\` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. This produces suboptimal query performance at scale. Resolve the issue by replacing \`auth.<function>()\` with \`(select auth.<function>())\`. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.

lints.name: multiple_permissive_policies
lints.title: Multiple Permissive Policies
lints.description: Detects if multiple permissive row level security policies are present on a table for the same \`role\` and \`action\` (e.g. insert). Multiple permissive policies are suboptimal for performance as each policy must be executed for every relevant query.

findings.detail: Table \`public.notifications\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`authenticated\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{notif_select_own,notifications_select_own}\`
Table \`public.tool_bookings\` has multiple permissive policies for role \`authenticated\` for action \`SELECT\`. Policies include \`{bookings_select_admin,bookings_select_own}\`

catalogQuery:
BEGIN READ ONLY;
SELECT clock_timestamp() AS captured_at, current_database() AS database_name, version() AS version;
SELECT c.conname, n.nspname AS table_schema, t.relname AS table_name,
 array(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY x(num, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=x.num ORDER BY ord) AS columns,
 array(SELECT format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY x(num, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=x.num ORDER BY ord) AS column_types,
 rn.nspname AS referenced_schema, rt.relname AS referenced_table,
 array(SELECT a.attname FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY x(num, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.confrelid AND a.attnum=x.num ORDER BY ord) AS referenced_columns,
 pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) AS definition,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',ic.relname,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready)) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid=c.conrelid) AS indexes
FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=c.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace
JOIN pg_class rt ON rt.oid=c.confrelid JOIN pg_namespace rn ON rn.oid=rt.relnamespace
WHERE c.contype='f' AND n.nspname='public' AND c.conname IN ('events_club_id_fkey','events_created_by_fkey','knowledge_articles_author_id_fkey','project_members_user_id_fkey','projects_club_id_fkey','fk_bookings_project','tool_bookings_approved_by_fkey','fk_users_club')
ORDER BY t.relname,c.conname;
COMMIT;
